row.notes: The broadcast grid rundown card's team badge (BroadcastGridRundownViewModel 0x1415ab930 -> card fill 0x141841a70, which declares the 'team_badge' holder at +0x1a0/+0x1a8 at 0x14184262f) is written in the driver info builder 0x141843640 at two places, both lea rcx,[rsi+0x1a0] then call 0x1407b10c0, which passes rdx (a NUL-terminated char buffer) to the string intern 0x1441974e0. rdx is not read after the call, so a MidHook may point rdx at another NUL-terminated key that lives for the run. This site (0x1418451bb, rdx=[rsp+0x60], buffer at rsp+0x68) is reached for entrants with a stock team index (word [rdi-0xe] != 0x3fff, the branch through 0x1418449c3 and 0x141844c94): a render badge path (0x141cbba30 at 0x141844da2) or #overrides.default.blank. Steam 26566308: 0x14184699b.
